endpoints.reach: Willow Mill Park to Good Hope Access
endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: cumberland_county_conodoguinet_b4 B4: The current Cumberland County Conodoguinet Creek Water Trail guide's B4 access table publishes 40.2578, -77.0426 for Willow Mill Park. The same guide identifies the site as a concrete boat launch with an improved ramp, short carry, and shallow slope to water; the guide page states the access table was updated in 2023-2024. Silver Spring Township independently confirms that a boat launch is at the rear of the park. The published coordinate is rounded to four decimal places and represents the public launch area, not a surveyed concrete-ramp toe.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (cumberland_county_conodoguinet_b4 B4) on Conodoguinet Creek; this confirms the public access site, not the exact water-edge point. Confirm the water-edge location and carry before paddling.

endpoints.reach: Willow Mill Park to Good Hope Access
endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: pa_pfbc_good_hope_conodoguinet_access OBJECTID 128 / ID_NO 665: The current PFBC-verified fishing and boating access layer identifies Good Hope in Cumberland County on Conodoguinet Creek, owned by PFBC and classified as an access area. Its point geometry (40.2588980574, -76.9763923626) replaces the route's geocoded road-address point. This is an access-area anchor, not a surveyed wet-edge coordinate.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (pa_pfbc_good_hope_conodoguinet_access OBJECTID 128 / ID_NO 665) on Conodoguinet Creek; this confirms the public access site, not the exact water-edge point. Confirm the water-edge location and carry before paddling.
